tasks.title: Verify cross-package normal directives and authored boot semantics
tasks.goal: Classify normal versus simple package directives and document the authored-project boot boundary without claiming the simple literal case is a bug.
steps: Build a disposable XML consumer with a normal-format umbrella and two statically required normal packages; test cross-package #use root/solution, #source transit and unresolved-address typed failure.
Compare the same authored snippet under simple format, where #use remains literal by contract, and verify #embed behavior without conflating the two formats.

Document that a project-owned static boot file named by INDEX is read as authored instructions rather than compiled as a package snippet; specify #source placement from parser behavior, including section/top-level versus last-line rule.
positive_cases: Normal cross-package #use inlines the exact target and source closure once; simple retains literal text.
An unresolved normal #use refuses before committing a changed boot lane.
negative_cases: The simple literal observation is labeled a confirmed normal-format bug.
A #source paragraph is silently accepted or relocated without its actual syntax rule.

tasks.title: Preserve XML host dialect and derived dependency state during init
tasks.goal: Make vibe init package add its own slot without converting the host XML boot lane or writing generated state into vibedeps.
steps: Reproduce init package in a disposable xml-spec_format project with existing STATIC.xml/INDEX and generated instruction blocks; capture host and derived dependency bytes before the command.
Carry the selected host dialect into boot regeneration or skip it when unnecessary; never default this path to Mixed/STATIC.md and never treat a vibedeps slot as a write target.
Characterize scaffold tool format/link defaults and static marker spelling against declared options and update only their documented mismatch.
positive_cases: The new package slot is present; host STATIC.xml and instruction blocks still name XML, and vibedeps remains byte-identical.
The same command remains correct for a Markdown-lane host.
negative_cases: Init package removes STATIC.xml or rewrites a dependency slot boot lane.
A quiet successful command hides a host dialect change or writes into derived dependencies.

tasks.title: Exclude generated slot lanes and protect authored workspace members
tasks.goal: Keep generated boot cache files out of package content and avoid writing host-generated lanes into source package members.
steps: Reproduce a simple package with static requires under an XML consumer, nested static zones and a multi-fragment zone; compare the current next tree with the reported main-only fixpoint behavior.

Classify generated slot boot/STATIC.*, INDEX.md and .vibe-boot-* as derived artifacts outside authored package traversal and #use targets; retain every authored fragment exactly once, including static_boot_count greater than one.

In a disposable workspace whose members are source package slots, snapshot each member and run install/check; either prove no source mutation or fix output placement so generated host lanes and lock records stay in the consumer-owned derived location.
positive_cases: XML and Markdown consumers install the same authored static closure without parsing a generated multi-document lane as one spec.
Source member directories remain byte-identical after consumer install; package check does not read a generated lane as an authored single document.
negative_cases: A generated slot STATIC.xml/INDEX/.vibe-boot file enters simple package content or becomes a #use target.
Dropping a substituted multi-fragment unit loses authored content; install writes host cache files into vibepacks source members.

tasks.title: Support long Windows materialization paths with truthful diagnostics
tasks.goal: Make package materialization usable from a long Windows project root and report exact path-length limits where the host cannot support a path.
steps: Reproduce a long-root, long-spec-filename package install in a disposable native Windows project; record the exact output path and failure stage, while keeping Linux/macOS paths usable.

Use supported Windows verbatim-path/no-follow operations for materialization where possible; otherwise refuse before partial install with an actionable diagnostic naming the path and needed root shortening.
Verify nested vibedeps/<group>.<name>/<version>/vibevm/vibespecs overhead and cleanup/retry truth after a failed materialization.
positive_cases: The native Windows long-root fixture installs or gives a correct pre-effect path-length refusal with a practical remedy.
The ordinary short-root fixture and Linux/macOS code path remain usable.
negative_cases: A path-length failure is reported as PROP-007 nesting/missing file with no length clue.
A portability limitation globally disables Linux or leaves a partly materialized slot reported as success.
